name: Gonna Be ??
storyline:
The protagonist, an elite member of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, is betrayed by his lover and drowns his sorrows in alcohol. He is taken in by an agent of the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office. Having lost all hope for the future, he steps into the ruthless world of espionage.

The protagonist, as "September," a member of the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office's agent team "Four Seasons," was conducting intelligence activities overseas. After completing a sabotage operation in a certain country, he reports to headquarters, where he is given a mission to infiltrate a girls' school. Though puzzled, he cannot disobey orders and heads to the scene. Disguised as a teacher, he encounters his ex-lover, "Miyuki," who had betrayed him and left him years ago, and receives a pill from her. Suspicious of Miyuki, who seems to know something, he swallows the pill...

Suddenly, the protagonist's body transforms into that of a "woman"! "What the heck is this?!" Miyuki says with a smile: "You have obtained a free pass to the school..." What is the reason why the protagonist, an agent, was sent to a mere girls' school? Switch between the guise of a "male teacher" and a "female student" to unravel the mysteries of the school!
